title: baccharis tricuneata var. magellanica
intro: Baccharis tricuneata var. magellanica, commonly known as Magellan's dwarf baccharis, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis tricuneata var. magellanica include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
